column1: # Proposed identifiers for DATA objects, the companion to name_proposals.tsv.
# Same rules: basis is recorded, and a symbol whose purpose the code does not
# establish is left out rather than guessed at.

column5: why

The map module's state block, referenced by 131 of the files we elevated. Holds the event counters at +0x16c, the event flag halfword at +0x170, the actor table, the looping sound id at +0xcc8 and the area fields.
The map view block: layer pointers at +0x130 with a 0x30-byte record per layer, the camera words at +4/+8/+0xc, the marker table and the camera bounds at +0xec.
The UI block: the window list, the text object at +0x620, the text control bytes at +0x12fa and the panel field group at +0xea8.
The party-menu module's state block: the grid node list at +0x48, the message box at +0x10c, the entry table at +0x134 and the actor scale table at +0x244.
The battle state block: unit records at +0x80 with a 0x2c-byte stride, the slot table at +0x64, and the turn phase words at +0x7fc through +0x804.
The battle camera and view record -- the three vectors, pitch and yaw that Battle_SetViewAngles writes and Battle_PollCameraKeys nudges.
The battle animation context: the counter group at +0x7790, the window registers at +0x77bc, the BG2 reference points at +0x77d0 and the blit block at +0x7818.
The field effect module's block, with sixteen effect slots from +0x58.
The screen-transition block: mode halfword at the head, then the pattern buffer the scanline hook feeds.
The option menu module's block: the node list, the cursor pair at +0x396 and the option record at +0x348.
The debug menu module's block.
The flash save scratch block: sixteen slot-status bytes at the head, the sector buffer from +0x40 and the payload from +0x50.
The field actor table: 64 records at a 0x70-byte stride, each with the collidable flag at +0x59 and the position at +8.
The global frame counter. Read as & 0xf for a phase gate, & 1 and & 2 for the two actor flicker variants, and >> 2 & 1 for the effect flicker.
The minimap module's block, holding the tracked actor and the projected arrow angle.
A small block whose first slot holds the currently open UI box; Battle_SetEndFlag writes its third word.
The sprite layer group table, indexed at +0x28 with four bytes per group and ten entries each.
The party status box block that UI_CloseStatusBox releases.
Already named. The 704-byte persistent record: coins at +0x10, party ids at +0x1f8, map id at +0x1d6, warp pairs at +0x1ce..+0x1d4, text speed at +0x205.
Already named. The 64KB scratch buffer the map renderer and the animation DMA both draw from.
GetItemInfo indexes it by item id masked to 0x1ff at a 0x2c-byte stride.
GetMoveInfo indexes it by move id masked to 0x3fff, bounded at 0x208, at a 0x10-byte stride.
GetClassInfo indexes it from +0x90 at a 0x54-byte stride.
GetSummonInfo indexes it by id up to 0xf at an 8-byte stride.
The 24-byte enemy stat rows, bounded at 0x2b, read by GetBaseStatSpread and GetEnemyStatRowWord.
The four-wide table GetClassStatEntry indexes as row times four plus column.
The eight-byte encounter rows, bounded at 0xab, behind GetEnemyGroupId, GetEnemyGroupSize and GetEnemyGroupEntry.
Signed (x, y) formation offsets read in pairs by GetBattlePositionOffset.
The look vectors Battle_SetupViewMatrix builds the view matrix from.
The signed offsets Battle_ApplyShakeOffset steps through.
The variant lists Battle_PickEncounterVariant chooses from at random.
32-byte glyph rows indexed by digit; UI_DrawDigit reads them.
Per-slot tilemap offsets UI_DrawDigit uses as its destination.
The 0x42-byte per-shop stock rows GrantShopStock walks.
The sprite sheet Menu_CreateIconSprite and Menu_CreateCursorSprite upload.
The three-by-three table GetMenuGridEntry reads.
The sixteen-entry facing table GetDPadDirection indexes with the four direction bits of gKeyHeld.
The signed palette nudges Actor_IdleFlicker picks from at random.
The (encounter, group) pairs GetMapEncounterGroup reads.
The per-tile encounter rows Field_CheckEncounterTile looks up.
The per-map overlay code entries Map_LoadOverlayCode loads from.
The idle variants MapActor_PickIdleVariant selects with the frame counter.
The two flicker values Effect_PickFlicker chooses between.
The tile permutation ScrambleSpriteTiles walks for the dissolve effect.
The option table StartMenu_ResetOptions clears and StartMenu_AddIconOption fills.
The packed palette StartMenu_BuildPalette expands.
